job.location: Throughout Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District, CA

items.item_text: 01. ASSESSMENT PROCESS: Only those candidates whose application demonstrates a combined education and experience which meets the minimum requirements for this position will be considered qualified to advance in the assessment process. All positions require qualified candidates to pass the assessment process which may include one or more of the following components: --A scored application screening and evaluation based on the candidate's education, work history, and responses to the supplemental questions. --A multiple-choice assessment specific to the position. --A performance evaluation (for example Microsoft Word, Excel, or other job related activity). --A technical oral assessment. (In most cases, this step will be conducted remotely utilizing an online meeting platform. If a candidate does not have access to reliable internet and the use of a camera-ready desktop/laptop with a microphone, arrangements will be made for candidate participation from the GCCCD Personnel Commission office.) Please Note: Depending on the volume of applicants, there may be instances when only the highest scoring candidates will advance to subsequent phases of the examination process. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above Assessment Process statement. Options: Yes | No

02. The following supplemental questions will help us determine if you meet the minimum qualification standards for this position. Additionally, the information provided in the answers to these questions will be considered if a scored evaluation of your training and experience is utilized during the assessment process. Respond honestly and truthfully to all questions. Over-evaluating your experience or skill level is considered providing false and/or misleading information. Applicants found to have provided false or misleading information of their skills or experience will be disqualified from further employment processing, or if hired, immediately terminated from employment. Experience listed below must be represented in the work history section of your application . A resume may be attached, but not substituted for completing the work history, education sections, or the supplemental questions of the employment application. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above statement. Options: Yes | No

03. What is your highest level of education completed? Please Note: If hired, proof of education will be required during onboarding. Options: High School Diploma or G.E.D. Equivalent | Some College | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate | None of the Above

04. If you have indicated a degree above, please state the area of concentration for your degree. If you have multiple degrees, please list all areas of concentration. If you did not indicate a degree, please answer N/A.

05. How many years of full time paid nursing experience in a public health or occupational health or school/college health setting do you have? Your related work experience must be clearly shown in the areas for work history on your application. Options: I do not have any related work experience. | I have been trained in this area but have no related work experience. | I have less than 1 year of related work experience | I have more than 1 year but less than 3 years of related work experience. | I have more than 3 years but less than 5 years of related work experience. | I have more than 5 years but less than 7 years of related work experience. | I have more than 7 years but less than 9 years of related work experience. | I have more than 9 years but less than 11 years of related work experience. | I have more than 11 years of related work experience.

06. Please describe the experience you have indicated above regarding your nursing experience in a public health or occupational health or school/college health setting. Be sure to include the following in the format presented: EMPLOYER: JOB TITLE: NUMBER OF HOURS WORKED PER WEEK: SPECIFIC DUTIES PERFORMED RELATED TO NURSING EXPERIENCE IN A PUBLIC HEALTH OR OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH OR SCHOOL/COLLEGE HEALTH SETTING: The experience listed must be represented in the work history section of your application. A resume may be attached, but not substituted for completing the work history, education sections, or the supplemental questions of the employment application. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" or generic answers such as "I have many years of experience" which do not adequately address the specific content of the question may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. If you have no experience, please answer N/A.
07. Do you possess a current California Board of Registered Nursing License? Options: Yes | No

08. Do you possess current certificates in cardiopulmonary resuscitation, first aid and AED (Automated External Defibrillator)? Please check ALL current certificates that you possess. Options: Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation | First Aid | Automated External Defibrillator (AED)
09. I am interested and available for substitute Health Services Nurse work and would like to be processed/hired for temporary substitute assignments. Options: Yes | No

10. Please select the answer that best describes your experience working in the area of governmental, public schools, community colleges, and/or universities. Please check all that apply. Options: No Governmental, public schools, or community college work experience. | Governmental | Public School | Community College | University

11. If the job classification for which you are applying has positions available (either now or during the life of the eligibility list) at any of the following locations, which would you be willing to interview for and accept employment? The Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District Offices provide services which support both campuses and are currently located on the Grossmont College campus. Both colleges offer hundreds of programs and student services tailored to meet diverse needs, while leading the region with the highest transfers to SDSU, and providing premier career and workforce training. Grossmont College has been recognized as a Champion of Higher Education for its Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) program, and offers premier programs such as allied health, nursing, culinary arts, science, fine and performing arts, and drone technology. Cuyamaca College is ranked “Best for Vets” and recognized for excellence in Black Transfer-level Math Success. Cuyamaca offers over 100 degrees and certificate programs, including innovative programs like water/wastewater technology, automotive technology, engineering, graphic design, ornamental horticulture, and environmental health and safety management. PLEASE NOTE: If a location is NOT selected, you will not be considered for employment at that location. Options: Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District Offices | Cuyamaca College | Grossmont College

EXPERIENCE: Responsible experience as a registered nurse within the past five years in a school/college health, acute care, or emergency health setting. Previous experience in a public health or occupational health setting is preferred. LICENSES AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS: A valid and current California Board of Registered Nursing License and current certificates in cardiopulmonary resuscitation, first aid and AED (Automated External Defibrillator). To view the complete job description please visit Health Services Nurse (Download PDF reader) .
EDUCATION: Completion of educational course work leading to licensure as a registered nurse in the state of California.
